title: Lost Mary Maryliq Sour Red 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Ignite your taste buds with an electrifying mix of fruits in Lost Mary Maryliq's Sour Red e-liquid. This flavour is a symphony of tangy Strawberries, zesty Lemon, and juicy Watermelon, perfectly blended to provide a mouth-puckering experience unlike any other. It's an adventurous flavour, ideal for those who crave something a little different but extraordinarily delightful. The balanced 50% VG / 50% PG blend ensures a smooth vaping experience with a satisfying throat hit and flavourful clouds, making it a hit for both newcomers and experienced vapers alike. If you're looking for a vape juice that delivers both tang and sweetness in a beautiful harmony, then Sour Red is the one for you.
